name: San Cristóbal de La Laguna
description: San Cristóbal de La Laguna is a historic town on the north side of Tenerife in the Canary Islands, and was once the island group's capital. Its old centre has two parts: a winding, organic Upper Town and a Lower Town laid out on a deliberate grid, a model later echoed in colonial cities. Wide streets are lined with 16th- to 18th-century churches and mansions.
